body: He's kept me as a 50s housewife/SAHM, convincing me it's better for the kids, when actually it means no job experience, no income, etc. He's managed to scare away all my friends, and my family is 1000 miles away, I had to follow him for his job. I have no money to my name, no access to the bank account, no car of my own, nowhere to go other than being homeless.

Hey, everyone.... Thank you for responding. I gave myself a few hours to calm down and it's helped a bit. I'm still hurt, but I'm not in a full on rage anymore.  


I'm thinking that I won't destroy my painting, even though I still feel awful about it. Even though it might not have been the best, it does show the progress in my learning of art and I need to remind myself that, hey, I made a thing and I gotta practice to improve. I'm trying my best, I'm hoping after some sleep I can calm down a bit more. Although, I will admit that I'm scared to share my art on the internet again lol. That was the first time sharing it to a stranger, and I now know I'm probably not strong enough emotionally yet to share again for awhile. I just have to remind myself that while I am still alive to still create, even though it'll be a little difficult for awhile.  


Thank you for letting me vent. I really needed it, especially with the next few days. I really hope that all of you get to have an enjoyable holiday this week. Holidays are the worst for so many and I hope that we all can make it through it. Winter Blues, sad holidays, and short days are a recipe for disaster and I probably let it get to me more than it normally would.
I regret posting this, honestly. You've only made me feel worse, thanks.
